title: MV ISO: Tall MV Generator parts, if they exist?

posts.author: daMooseNeo
posts.body:
I'm recovering from a fairly catastrophic harddrive failure, and resources that should have been backed up, thought were backed up, were in fact NOT backed up.
In recovering data, I've lucked out and recovered or rebuilt a lot of data. None of it has labels, meta data, etc. however. So, I can't run down some old stuff because I don't have much in the way of tags.
One of my last things to recover are my tall sprites; I had a pack of RTP character tall sprites and I THOUGHT there were generator parts to go with them, but devil if I can lay my hands on them.
Could anyone help with A) Identifying the author/source of the following sheet and
, point me toward generator parts sized for these guys??
EDIT: I think I have the pack identified; "TF Tall Sprite MV" on itch.io (and I did find a link here eventually too).
https://tobishima.itch.io/tf-tallspritemv
Now, however, I still swear there was a generator pack for these but no dice so far. I had, and recovered, the face of a custom character I knew was in the project with these tall sprites, but have not found in the mess of files a sprite set nor a real clue of a generator set.
I HAVE used SumRndDev's CharacterGeneratorEX, and was able to reobtain that, along with HiddenOne's generator kit, but those don't seem to have what I'm looking for.
